Let me design coordinates. Canvas 400x300. Bicycle centered lower, pelican above.

Bicycle: wheels radius 40, centers at (110, 220) and (270, 220). Frame lines connecting. Handlebars near front, seat near rear-ish top.

Pelican: body oval around (200, 130), head above with long beak extending forward, eye, wing reaching to handlebars, legs down to pedals.

Let me draft carefully.

Wheels: circles cx=110 cy=225 r=38; cx=280 cy=225 r=38. Spokes optional. Tires thick stroke.

Frame: rear wheel hub (110,225), bottom bracket (195,225), front hub (280,225). Seat tube from bracket to seat (175,145). Down tube bracket to head tube (255,150). Top tube seat to head tube. Chainstay rear hub to bracket. Seatstay rear hub to seat. Fork head tube to front hub. Handlebars at (255,140) going up to (265,130) with curve.

Pelican sits on seat at (175,145). Body: ellipse center (165,110) rx=40 ry=30, white/gray. Tail on left. Neck/head: head circle at (205,70) r=15. Beak: long pouch extending right from head, from (215,70) to (280,80), with pouch below. Eye dot.

Wing: from body to handlebar — a shape reaching (255,140). Legs: two lines from body down to pedals at (195,225)? Pedals: crank circle at bracket, pedal lines. Feet (webbed) on pedals — draw small webbed foot triangles.

Add motion lines behind maybe. Keep it clean and whimsical.

Colors: pelican body white/light gray #f0f0f0, beak orange #f4a460 or #ff9966. Bicycle frame dark blue #2b6cb0 or red #e53e3e. Wheels black/dark gray.

Seat: pelican sits on seat; draw seat before pelican body.
